title: Distance to a quadratic flip neighbor
statement: Let $n$ be a nonzero integer with $2\le n$, and let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$. The relative Hamming distance from $w$ to its complete quadratic flip neighbor is at most $2/n$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $n$
